detail.longDescription: Hello guys, the stable version of PH4NTXM, just released! For those who don't know, PH4NTXM is the very first Hacking distribution with Greek roots. I built it entirely around a zero-trust philosophy. Because I truly believe in absolute transparency, I am making this stable release available to build directly from source. This means you can check it, audit it, verify everything yourself, and then build it. No hidden surprises, just pure open-source power. This project belongs to the community now. I’ve always wanted to give something back to the amazing open-source world that has given me so much over the years, and this is my personal contribution. I would absolutely love to see more people embracing it, testing it, and breaking it! Whether you want to contribute code, give me some feedback, or just look under the hood, you are more than welcome. https:// github.com/PH4NTXMOFFICIAL/PH4 NTXM # PH4NTXM # Linux # Debian # OS # Live # Privacy # Security # OpSec # InfoSec # Research # Tech # Technology
